scope: Fresh LP fine/coarse differences for each epsilon. Existing adopted direct coarse/fine difference separately; it is not a refinement estimate for the two new pairs. Finite-minus-LP differences also include residual integration/solver errors.
runtime_limitations: Archived adopted pair was generated under its recorded older NumPy/SciPy environment. Fresh runs use the recorded current environment; cross-runtime comparisons are numerical diagnostics, not pure analytical error bounds.
